# Ripplecheck

> Ripplecheck compiles breaking warehouse DDL into a DataHub-backed counterfactual, policy proof, migration DAG, and PR pack.

## Key routes

- [Interactive demo](/)
- [Health check](/health)
- [Demo scenarios](/api/scenarios)

## Agent behavior

Ripplecheck resolves a dataset, verifies a column, traces exact downstream lineage paths, loads owners and criticality, projects the graph after a proposed change, proves stable release rules, compiles owner-routed migration work, generates a six-file ZIP, and optionally writes a hash-sealed capsule back to DataHub.

The public demo uses a synthetic offline DataHub snapshot and requires no key or paid service. Live mode connects to the official DataHub MCP Server.
